run_verify_benchmark_scores_cli: run the CLI to verify benchmark scores from a JSON file for a given benchmark type
test_verify_det: test the verify_det function to validate detection metrics precision and recall thresholds
test_verify_rec: test the verify_rec function to validate recognition average score threshold
test_verify_layout: test the verify_layout function to validate layout metrics precision and recall thresholds
test_verify_order: test the verify_order function to validate ordering mean accuracy threshold
test_verify_table_rec: test the verify_table_rec function to validate table recognition row and column IoU thresholds
test_verify_texify: test the verify_texify function to validate texify edit distance threshold
